derivation: adverb from the same as G1675 (Ἑλληνιστής);
def: Hellenistically, i.e. in the Grecian language

occurrences.text: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
